verdict.rationale: Deepgram's dedicated diarization docs show that a developer enables speaker diarization on a request with the diarize_model parameter, which also selects the model version. This first-party evidence covers the core of the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the per-word or per-utterance speaker labels in the response, details on speaker-count accuracy or limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the speaker labels are accurate.
